name: Nakagihara Mau
source:
Mau is a highly energetic girl who specializes in producing boys love stories for girls. She is truly a devotee to the genre, and will discuss it for hours on end if one can goad her into it. The protagonist hires Mau due to his strong lack of knowledge in the popular niche market. Mau recently ended a dating relationship with a longtime friend and classmate due to disagreements with the constructiveness of her hobby.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064835/www.elizar.com/?p=7]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
